topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines the intended learning outcomes regarding cancer evolution and the tumour microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms in clonal selection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how both Darwinian selection of genetic mutations and epigenetic modifications drive clonal advantage and tumour initiation.

topics.label: Stem cell properties and cell of origin in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine stem cell hierarchies, cancer stem cell models, and experimental evidence regarding the cell of origin across different malignancies.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory influences on tumour development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how chronic inflammation, environmental promoters, and stromal dependencies provide permissive conditions for tumour growth and malignant progression.

topics.label: Methods for investigating tumour evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the experimental and computational technologies used to map mutational timing, cellular plasticity, and microenvironmental interactions in tumours.

topics.label: Multifactorial synthesis of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesises how mutational accumulation, epigenetic plasticity, cell of origin, and microenvironmental coevolution interact to permit cancer outgrowth.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding remarks for the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
